visual_base.visual_narrative_log:
(1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a glossy product box featuring a stylized artistic illustration of a female figure with voluminous, long black hair and a white dress. The character is surrounded by floating black VHS tapes on the box art. Various text overlays are visible at the bottom and sides of the frame against a neutral background. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the package's design and brand identity.
(2) A pair of hands enters the frame to pull the inner plastic tray containing the figure out of the main cardboard box. The person's skin and fingers are clearly visible as they handle the items. The background is a soft, grey upholstered fabric surface, likely a sofa or bed, under bright indoor lighting. The camera follows the movement of the box as it is being dismantled.
(3) The reviewer carefully removes a thin sheet of white protective plastic from the main figure. As the plastic is peeled away, the detailed sculpting of the figure's long, black, wavy hair and its white gown is revealed. The figure is in a curled-up, floating pose with bare feet and legs exposed. Close-up shots focus on the fine details of the red-painted nails on the fingers and toes.
(4) The camera shifts to focus on the statue's base, which is designed as a dense, haphazard pile of black VHS tapes. A hand is seen placing the main figure onto a metal support pin protruding from the center of this base. The VHS tapes on the base are highly detailed, featuring small grey reel windows and textured labels, creating a thematic foundation for the horror-themed collectible.
(5) In this phase, the reviewer attaches small accessory pieces, which are individual floating VHS tapes, to various points on the figure's hair and clothes using tiny transparent pegs. The camera pans around the figure to show these additions from multiple angles, emphasizing the three-dimensional composition. The bright indoor lighting creates soft shadows and highlights on the white fabric of the character's gown.
(6) A small black rectangular box, designed to look like a VHS tape, is opened to reveal a set of interchangeable face plates and film strip accessories. One face plate features a single large, staring eye peeking through long hair. The reviewer's hands are shown carefully picking up these parts from a clear plastic tray inside the accessory box. The background remains consistent with the previous scenes.
(7) The final phase showcases the fully assembled statue as it is slowly rotated on its base by the reviewer's hands. The camera zooms in for several close-up shots of the different face plates, including one with the single staring eye. At one point, the reviewer's face and shoulder-length hair are partially visible in the background. The lighting becomes more dynamic, with cinematic glares reflecting off the figure's surfaces as it spins.
